confidence_notes: Current Dubrovnik food and drink benchmarks are based on recent city cost-of-living data, but the contributor sample is small and tourist-area prices vary sharply by season. Cocktail and wine estimates use a current local guide; accommodation is a holistic estimate without live listings and is especially season-sensitive.
comparable_city_reasoning: Dubrovnik is a high-demand Adriatic tourist city; dining estimates use city-specific prices, while accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of coastal Croatian destinations with a strong Old Town premium and pronounced seasonality.
